MERCHANT ON-RAMPS AND RANGE | FY2018-Q3 2026 | G1-G6
[I] Bet: widen entry, help merchants scale, monetize their activity.
[I] Engine: acquisition + merchant growth + adoption feed revenue.
|
+-- GETTING MERCHANTS IN
|   +-- [R] Base: 820k (2018), 1.749M (2020), 2.063M (2021).
|   +-- [S] 2019 base: 1.069M; [R] FY2022 onward: "millions".
|   +-- [S] Count alone misses merchant size and service adoption.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2022-Q1 2024: acquisition +180%, CAC down almost 60%.
|   +-- [S] First-time sellers 7x since 2018; starting count absent.
|   +-- [S] 2019 brand campaign: awareness rose; suspended Q1 2020.
|   `-- brand -[untestable]-> conversion / marketing efficiency
|
+-- TRIALS: AN ADAPTING INITIATIVE
|   +-- [S] 2020: 14-day -> 90-day free -> 14-day trials.
|   +-- [S] 2022: free/paid trials defer near-term MRR.
|   +-- [S] 2024: three -> one month; late 2024: back to three.
|   +-- [S] MRR growth: +9% Q2 2025 -> +19% Q3 2026.
|   `-- trial length -[assoc]-> MRR; pricing comparisons overlap
|
+-- PRICING AND MEASUREMENT
|   +-- [S] Standard prices changed Jan-Apr 2023.
|   +-- [S] MRR $116M -> $139M in Q2 2023; price led dollar growth.
|   +-- [S] 2024 Plus: most existing merchants lock old rates 3 years.
|   +-- price -[claim]-> retention resilience
|   `-- [S] Q1 2024 MRR method changes; revenue unaffected.
|
+-- MOVING UPMARKET
|   +-- [S] Plus MRR share: 25% 2018 -> 34% Q1 2023 / Q3 2026.
|   +-- [R] FY2024: Plus + enterprise generate the majority of GMV.
|   +-- [S] Plus entry includes both new merchants and upgrades.
|   +-- [S] CCS launched in 2023; integrators expand enterprise reach.
|   +-- CCS + integrators -[claim]-> enterprise adoption
|   +-- [S] Q1 2026: $100M+ GMV merchant count nearly doubles in 2 years.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2025: under-$25M merchants still generate most GMV.
|
+-- PHYSICAL RETAIL AS AN ENTRY POINT
|   +-- [S] Retail Plan launched Aug 2023 at $89/month.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2026: 55% adding POS were new to Shopify.
|   `-- [I] One quarter's merchant mix; not a revenue contribution.
|
+-- MERCHANT OUTCOMES AND COHORTS
|   +-- [R] Same-merchant GMV growth: 29% / 24% / 21% in 2017-19.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2015 cohort reaches 5x initial quarterly GMV.
|   +-- [S] 38 of 39 quarterly cohorts outpace US e-commerce since entry.
|   +-- [S] $1M+ GMV merchants: 92% retention; period definition unclear.
|   +-- [S] Q4 2023: exact churn numbers not given.
|   `-- [I] Seed's chart-based contradiction cannot be rechecked here.
|
+-- BEATING THE MARKET
|   +-- [S] Three-year online CAGR: US 23% vs 8%; Europe 37% vs 8%.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2026 GMV growth evenly split: new and same-store sales.
|   +-- [I] Platform growth includes acquisition and migration.
|   `-- merchant success -[assoc]-> Shopify results; no control supplied
|
+-- REPORTED STRUCTURE
|   +-- [S] Q3 2026: Standard, Plus and variable fees grow subscriptions.
|   `-- [S] GMV + payments penetration drive Merchant Solutions.
|
[R] Filing figure or direct filing arithmetic. [S] Management/narrative.
[I] Interpretation. [X] Contradicted claim; requires supplied evidence.
Links: mech | causal (none established) | assoc | data | claim |
       untestable | contra. Detail edges organize, not causal claims.
MRR = monthly recurring revenue; GMV = gross merchandise volume.
[I] Missing denominators prevent acquisition claims from proving retention.
[I] Cohort growth can reflect survivors and monetization, not universal success.
